label: Series systems
subgoals: Multiply the reliabilities of parts in series
Combine identical Weibull parts into one with scale eta times n to the minus 1 over beta
Explain the weakest-link shortening of chip life

label: Triple modular redundancy
subgoals: Count the cases where at least two of three modules work
Check that the module reliability exceeds one half

label: Parallel and k-of-n redundancy
subgoals: Compute the probability that all parallel paths fail
Subtract it from one for the parallel reliability
Identify common-cause failures as the limit of redundancy
